mentions.name: MeMovee
mentions.description: An agentic movie search product with API access that lets companies embed natural-language smart search into their streaming apps or movie tracker apps. It answers conversational queries such as top-rated movies by year, genre picks (e.g. zombie apocalypse or space movies), horror exclusions, vote-count filters, and similarity-based recommendations like movies similar to Blade Runner.
mentions.audience: Companies building streaming apps or movie tracker apps
